SIND CANAL WATER
FLAT RATE RULES, 1972
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, 23rd December 1972
No. 2/4O (R & S)/70,‑In
exercise of the powers conferred under section 70 of the Sind Irrigation Act,
1879 in supersession of all previous rules in this behalf the' Government of
Sind are pleased to make the following
rules for date determination of rates leviable for amount to be charged for the
use of Canal Water for purposes of irrigation under section 44 of the said Act.
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These rules may be
called the Sind Canal Water Flat Rate Rules, 1972.
(2) These rules shall come into
force from commencement of the agricultural year 19-12‑73.
2. . Definitions.‑In
these rules unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "Act" means the
Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 (Sind Act VII of 1879).
{b) "Appellate
Authority" means the Collector of the District, having jurisdiction over
assessing authority or any other officer so designated by B. O. R. from time to
time.
(c) "Area" means
total area of Deh as recorded in village Form No. t of the concerned Deh, less‑
(i) land which is occupied as
the site of a town or village ; `
(ii) ghair mumkin Area ;
(iii) land set apart for special and public purposes
; ,
(iv) land cultivated exclusively by Well or Tubewells
;
(v) barani and Sailabi lands;
(vi) other naqabuli land not let out ;
(d) "Assessing
Authority" means the Assistant Collector First and Second Grade incharge
of a Taluka or Mahal having jurisdiction over the Assessing Unit or any other
officer designated as ‑such by the Board of Revenue from time to time ;
(e) "!Assessment
Unit" means Deh (Revenue Village).
(f) "Authentication Authority" means the
Assistant Commissioner having their jurisdiction over tile assessment units or
any other officer designated as such by the Board of Revenue from time to time
;
(g) "Banjar Jadid"
means land which his remained unsown for eight or more successive harvests, bat
less than 12 successive harvests. ‑
(h) "Banjar Qadim" means land which has
remained unsown for twelve or more successive harvests. .
(i) "Barani" means
land dependent on rainfall.
(j) "Established rice land" means the land
which has sanctioned water supply from perennial canal for rice cultivation.
(k) "Flow" means land irrigated by flow
mode of irrigation from canals: '
(I) "Ghair Mumkin" means land which has for any
reason become permanently unculturable, such as land under roads, , buildings,
streams, canals, karazos,‑ tanks or the like, or land which' is, barren,
sandy or ravines. .
(m) "Jamabandi" means the aggregate demand
of water rate for a year.
(n) "Lift" means land irrigated by lifting
canal water. .
(o) "Orchard" means sanctioned garden land
under fruit trees planted to a , density of 25 trees or more per acre grown and
planted by human effort.
(p) ` Sailabi" means land flooded or kept
permanently moist by a river ;
(q) "Tail end" means
survey numbers settled on a watercourse at or about the termination of the
irrigation channels which' in the opinion of the Assessing Authority acting in
consultation with Canal Officer not lower in rank than Executive Engineer are
subject to inequalities of canal water supply due to one or more of the
following factors :‑
(r) length or (ii) excessive‑absorption on ‑account
of sandy soil or (iii) alignment of channel or (iv) presence of sand drifts or
(v) high land. Such ‑survey Nos. shall be approved and notified by the
Board of Revenue , from time to time.
3. Assessing Authority and
Authentication Authority.‑Assessing Authority and Authentication
Authority shall exercise such powers and perform such duties as may be
prescribed under these rules. .
4. Ascertainment of Rate.‑(1)
The flat rate for supply of water shall for the first time be ascertained by
dividing the average of water rates assessed 9n Jamabandi of the concerned deh
for the three years ending with agricultural year 1970‑71 by the average
of the area of the respective deh for
sections.punishment:
shall be liable to a surcharge equivalent
to the water rate determined for flow land in the same Deh In addition to the
ordinary assessment of water rate.
